# CANDIDATE: NR4_VWAP_RIBBON_BREAKOUT_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A four-bar narrow-range contraction (NR4) signals volatility compression, which often precedes explosive directional moves. When this contraction resolves with a break above the prior high, supported by VWAP and a bullish EMA ribbon (8 > 21 > 34), it indicates high-probability continuation. This edge exists because NR4 identifies coiled energy, VWAP confirms institutional alignment, and the EMA ribbon provides trend-filtered momentum.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** When (1) the 4-bar range (highest high - lowest low of last 4 bars) < 20-bar ATR (volatility compression), (2) current bar closes above the highest high of those 4 bars (breakout), (3) price is above VWAP, and (4) 8/21/34 EMA ribbon is bullish (8 EMA > 21 EMA > 34 EMA), enter long at the close of the breakout bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the 4-bar NR4 box. TP1 at 1.5R (risk = entry - NR4 low). After TP1, trail runner stop at 15% below high-water mark. Time exit at 15:50 ET.
